attestations.text: CHIANG Fan 江藩 (T. 子屏, 節甫, H. 鄭堂), Apr. 26, 1761–1831, native of Kan-ch'uan (Yang-chow), was a scholar of the Soochow School (see under Hui Tung). His ancestral home was in Ching-tê, Anhwei.
